serializacion.ayudaActualizar:
Reloads the users stored in the database into the grid.
Discards anything loaded from an XML file and re-enables add/edit actions.
serializacion.ayudaLimpiar:
Clears the data grid, the user fields, the selected paths and the message.
Nothing is deleted from the database or the XML files. Press Refresh to see the users again.
serializacion.ayudaSerializar:
Saves the users shown in the grid to an XML file.
First choose the location and file name with the folder button.
serializacion.ayudaDeserializar:
Reads the selected XML file and shows its users in the grid (on screen only, not saved to the database).
First choose the file with the folder button.
